audit_scope: independent data/schedule feasibility audit of the six V12 blind proposals; schedule-only (counts, spans, weight algebra, transition-cost bounds). NO returns, PnL, PF, Sharpe, performance ranking or backtest was computed.

worktree.bootstrap_note: the specified worktree did not exist at audit start; A9-F created it deterministically via `git worktree add -b orca/v12d-a9f-feasibility <path> 9c176797ec23352b96047d5c41108da7ff13fe8b` and then re-ran the identity gate (HEAD == bootstrap SHA, branch as specified, porcelain empty). No other branch was touched.

decision_grid.note: normalization uses the 357d span between first and last stamp, matching cost_feasibility.decisions_per_365d semantics; all stamps are scheduled discretionary decisions including carried-forward/no-action stamps

bars.ts_event_range_all_symbols: 2024-08-21/23 .. 2026-08-21/23 (per-symbol; covers S0 plus >= 364d of pre-window warmup history)
bars.close_decode_scale: close column is a Nautilus raw fixed-point i128 equal to price x 1e16 for every symbol/file; cross-validated per file against the bar's own taker_buy_quote_volume / taker_buy_base_volume ratio (median rel err ~1e-3). Scoring lanes must decode with this scale, not the file price_precision metadata.

eth_gap.effect: ETHUSDT fails full-coverage eligibility at the first stamp (and for any trailing window that overlaps the gap: 28d windows through 2025-09-15 stamp, 56d through 2025-10-13, 90d through 2025-11-17); breadth impact 19->18 names, far above the 9-name floor

funding.pit_conclusion: no settlement spacing exceeds 8h for any symbol in the S0 window, so the frozen PIT span rule (settlement inside [ts_opened, ts_closed], no hole > 8h) is serviceable for all 20 symbols; the data_contract hole counter flags ACE/ONG (2097/2182 'holes') purely as cadence-change suspects, not lost settlements

oi.note: all six proposals explicitly declare OI never read; deep OI verification out of scope per audit task 1

instrument_metadata.note: one adverse tick is worth at most ~6bp of price across the universe at stamp fill prices; the 5bp taker fee floor in metadata matches the declared tier-0 floor

task2_warmup_feasibility.method: loader-selected: for every weekly Monday 00:00Z stamp in S0, count missing completed 15m slots in the exact trailing 28d/56d/90d windows; cross-checked with data_contract.warmup_report

first_stamp_status.2025-08-25T00:00:00Z: 18 of 19 tradeable names have a fully covered 90d block (all but ETHUSDT); 28d/56d coverage identical exclusion set
first_stamp_status.fail_closed_precondition_10_of_19: PASS for A5-P1, A5-P2 (both declare >=10 of 19 required)

all_52_stamps.summary: only the 13 stamps whose trailing 90d window overlaps the single ETH gap lose one name; every other symbol covers every horizon at every stamp
all_52_stamps.folds: 52 weekly stamps support 3 chronological folds with purge >= max holding (4 instants for 28d BAB, 8 for RVX) with >= 2 surviving instants per fold; 13 monthly OSCOMP stamps support 3 folds with 1-stamp purge

task2_warmup_feasibility.a8_p2_weekly_ticket_warmup: 12 weekly ticket observations required from the trailing 90d: available at every stamp for 18-19 names (pre-window history extends 364d before S0 start)

task3_breadth_at_stamps.method: features computed PIT at each declared stamp from completed bars; books constructed per each proposal's own declared rules (extreme-4 legs, beta-neutral leg rescale, 0.30 uniform shrink); weekly grid for A5/A8, every-4th-Monday grid for OSCOMP, threshold pairs for RVX

quintile_families.eligible_names_min_max: 18-19 (floor >= 9 PASS at every stamp for every proposal)
quintile_families.note_on_bab_gross: the beta-neutral leg rescale (m = mean(beta_short)/mean(beta_long)) inflates book gross to ~1.39x unit for the BAB books; the declared uniform 0.30 shrink keeps max|w| <= 0.30 (observed 0.2909). No frozen floor bounds gross, so this is a leverage property to disclose, not a feasibility failure.

rvx_pairs.pairs_computable_56d_coverage: >= 7 of 8 pairs at every stamp (min 7; ETH/SOL blocked only while the ETH gap is inside its 56d window)
rvx_pairs.falsification_condition_c_check: PASS: 8 of 8 pre-registered pairs are activatable at some stamp (condition kills the family only if < 2 ever activatable)
rvx_pairs.signal_availability_interpretation: data availability (both legs' 56d complete + test computable) is 100% of stamps for >= 7 pairs; threshold dormancy (|z| < 2) is a no-trade state, not unavailability

task3_breadth_at_stamps.a5p2_data_quality_gate: share of 15m bars with trade count > 0 is 1.0 at all sampled stamps in both 30d and 60d sub-windows; the >= 0.8 gate never excluded any name beyond the ETH coverage exclusion (min eligible 18)

task4_schedule_cost_turnover.method: declared rules simulated on real features across all stamps -> one-way transition deltas (sum |w_new - w_prev|, weight units, no prices/returns) -> priced with the frozen adapter arithmetic (taker 5bp per side + 1 adverse tick baseline; fee x1.5 + 3 ticks stressed) at 00:15Z bar-close fill prices; annualized over the first-to-last stamp span, divided by realized mean gross. Two variants reported: the declared hysteresis and a NO-HYSTERESIS conservative upper bound (re-form extreme legs every stamp). Terminal force-flat turnover NOT included (adds <= 1.4 units once for BAB books; conclusions unchanged).

H-A6-OSCOMP.note: proposal's own 12.5% share bound compares a 0.5-unit single-symbol flip against the 4.0-unit worst-case stamp turnover; against ACTUAL turnover the conservative share is 17.7% (DOGE) -- floor 25% still PASS

H-A6-RVX.note: mean gross 0.32 because 0-2 pairs are typically concurrent (entries need |z|>=2 at a weekly stamp); drag divides by realized gross, hence the slightly higher ratio vs turnover alone

A8-P1-BAB-PERP.note: A8-P1's extra churn guards (max 2 swaps/leg/stamp, 1-stamp re-entry rest, <=6 exits/symbol/365d) were NOT simulated; they only reduce the reported conservative bound

floor_verdicts.median_intended_holding_days_gte_3: PASS all six (weekly clock makes every completed span a multiple of 7d)
floor_verdicts.base_drag_lte_0.08: PASS all six (worst observed 0.0315 conservative, A8-P2)
floor_verdicts.stressed_drag_lte_0.12: PASS all six (worst observed 0.0596 conservative, A8-P2)
floor_verdicts.max_symbol_turnover_share_lte_0.25: PASS all six (worst observed 0.177 conservative, OSCOMP)

task5_adapter_compatibility.verdict: ALL SIX EXPRESSIBLE with the existing research/adapter_v10 interfaces; no new adapter capability required

mapping.stamps: ImmutableSchedule (strictly increasing Monday 00:00Z epoch ns; OSCOMP uses a every-4th-Monday subset)
mapping.books: TargetBook(weights mapping, carried_forward, reason_code) covers quintile books, the OSCOMP 4-vs-4 book, and RVX threshold pairs; beta-neutral leg rescale and the 0.30 shrink happen inside the deterministic target-book constructor before the stamp is emitted
mapping.fills: FillRecord FILLED_NEXT_EVENT with fill at the 00:15Z bar close matches the declared one-lag execution; StressSpec.event_delay_events=1 yields the strictly-later stressed fill
mapping.funding: SettlementPoint per symbol + LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE; mixed 8h/4h/1h cadences consumed natively; validate_funding_span_coverage at the 8h max interval passes for all 20 symbols
mapping.stress: StressSpec(fee_multiplier, tick_slip_ticks, event_delay_events, drop_symbols, dropped_fold_index) covers the exact frozen surface (x1.5, +2 ticks, +1 event, drop-one-symbol re-derivation via universe(stress), drop-one-fold)
mapping.costs: GenericStrategyBase.rebalance_cost_between reused verbatim (verified line-by-line); per-symbol tick sizes flow through CostModel.default_tick_sizes
mapping.gate: research/v11/cost_feasibility.evaluate_schedule_cost_feasibility consumes exactly the artifacts these schedules produce (instants, decisions, fill-price cost inputs, settlement cadences, signal availability)

caveats: H-A6-RVX needs an Engle-Granger/ADF implementation: neither statsmodels nor scipy is installed in the project venv. A pure-numpy ADF (delta-e on e_lag + const + 1 lag; MacKinnon EG 10% critical value ~ -3.05 for 2 variables) was used for this audit and is sufficient for scoring if frozen; otherwise a dependency must be added BEFORE scoring.

H-A6-OSCOMP's declared dollar-neutrality clause ('gross_long = gross_short = G, G in [1.0, 2.0]') contradicts its own beta-neutral split equation and would breach the 0.25/0.30 cap for G > 1.2; the cap-feasible subrange is side-gross <= 1.2 (legs <= 0.30). Observed books at side-gross 1.0 satisfy everything with the clamp binding at 0.30 on some stamps.

task6_resource_estimate.measured: the full audit feature pass (20 symbols x ~35k bars, per-stamp 28/56/90d coverage grids, 90d betas at 52 stamps, 30/60d and weekly-ticket aggregates, 8 EG tests x 52 stamps, book construction and cost pricing for six families) runs in ~6s wall, peak RSS well under 1GB
task6_resource_estimate.estimate: production feature generation + weekly/monthly stamp books for all six families on the S0 window: minutes of compute, < 2GB RAM on an 8GB M1; repeated stress cells multiply only cheap schedule arithmetic. No resource risk; full backtest out of scope.

findings.finding: ETHUSDT has a single 57-slot bar gap on 2025-08-21 (00:00-14:30Z), making it ineligible at early stamps for any window overlapping the gap (worst case: 13 of 52 stamps for the 90d beta). Breadth stays 18 of 19; every >= 10-of-19 fail-closed precondition passes.

Internal inconsistency: the declared equal-side gross band G in [1.0, 2.0] contradicts the beta-neutral split equation and the claimed |w| <= 0.25 construction (side gross 1.0 already gives 0.25 legs; G > 1.2 breaches the 0.30 cap without clamping). Resolvable by fixing side-gross <= 1.2 with the declared clamp; observed books at side-gross 1.0 are fully feasible (max|w| exactly 0.30 on clamped stamps). Scoring lane must implement the cap-clamped variant.

The declared 12.5% max symbol turnover share bound uses the 4.0-unit worst-case stamp turnover as denominator while the numerator comes from typical stamps; the measured conservative share is 17.7% (DOGE). The 25% floor still passes; the declared bound reasoning is invalid and should not be relied on.

No statsmodels/scipy in the venv: the Engle-Granger/ADF activation gate must be implemented in numpy (audit used delta-on-lag ADF with the MacKinnon EG 10% critical value -3.05 approximation) or a dependency added, BEFORE scoring. Critical values and lag choice must be frozen by the scoring lane.

Threshold activation is sparse: >= 1 pair activatable at 34/52 stamps, >= 2 at 18/52; mean gross 0.32 of unit. This matches the declared threshold-pairs shape (waives the >= 4-per-leg floor by its declared shape) but the family's realized book is often 0-2 pairs; concentration is inherent to the declared design.

Beta-neutral leg rescale inflates book gross to ~1.39x unit (long-leg betas lower than short-leg betas). The declared 0.30 uniform shrink holds max|w| <= 0.30 (observed 0.2909). No frozen floor bounds gross; disclose as a leverage property.

Bar close columns decode as raw_i128 / 1e16, NOT price_increment-derived precision. The file-level price_precision metadata does not give the scale. All consumers (scoring lanes) must use the 1e16 scale, cross-validated here against per-bar taker quote/base ratios for every symbol/file.

Funding cadence changes (ACE 1h/2h/8h, ONG 1h/4h/8h phases) make data_contract's hole counter report 2097/2182 cosmetic 'holes'; the true max settlement spacing is 8.0h for every symbol, so the frozen PIT span rule is never violated.

A8-P1/P2's explicit churn guards (max 2 swaps/leg/stamp, re-entry rest, <= 6 exits/symbol/365d) were not simulated; the reported conservative no-hysteresis bounds already pass every floor without them.

V12-A5-P1-BAB-LOWBETA.decisive_reason: 90d warmup satisfied for 18/19 names at the first stamp; breadth 18-19 (legs 4/4) at every stamp; max|w| 0.2909; drag 0.35%/0.65% (1.0%/1.7% conservative) vs 8%/12% floors; no floor breached under the no-hysteresis conservative bound.

V12-A5-P2-MIX-ORDERSIZE.decisive_reason: quote_volume + trade-count columns verified for all 19 names (fail-closed precondition met); trades>0 gate passes 100%; breadth 18-19; drag 1.5%/2.9% (1.7%/3.3% conservative); all floors pass.

H-A6-OSCOMP.decisive_reason: 13 monthly decisions/365d = 14.1; breadth 18-19 with 4/4 legs; 28d formation fully covered at every stamp except ETH's 4 early stamps; drag 0.35%/0.66%; symbol share 17.7% < 25%. F2 (G-band inconsistency) is construction-clarity, not data impossibility.

H-A6-RVX.decisive_reason: 56d pair coverage computable for >= 7 of 8 pairs at every stamp; all 8 pairs ever threshold-activatable (falsification condition (c) passes); turnover 4.9 units/yr, drag 1.0%/1.9%; max|w| 0.25; symbol share 10.4%. F4 (EG implementation) must be resolved before scoring but is implementable in numpy today.

A8-P1-BAB-PERP.decisive_reason: identical feasible skeleton to A5-P1 on real data (53.17 dec/365d, breadth 18-19, median holding 77d, drag 0.35%/0.65% conservative 0.87%/1.6%, symbol share <= 16.5%); its additional churn guards only tighten the reported bounds.

A8-P2-TICKET-MIX-CONTRARIAN.decisive_reason: highest-turnover of the six (33.3/yr hysteresis, 45.5/yr conservative) yet drag 2.3%/4.4% conservative 3.1%/6.0% stays inside the 8%/12% floors; breadth 18-19; median holding 14d; symbol share <= 11.5%.

blind_lane_note: per proposal declarations, every scored floor check remains the scoring lanes' schedule-only gate (research/v11/cost_feasibility.py) on the emitted books; this audit's numbers are independent verifier estimates under the same frozen arithmetic, not a substitute verdict.
